personal.name: Susano Kevin Amala Mahil Maran
personal.title: AI Engineer
personal.summary: AI Engineer with production experience building multi-agent systems, RAG pipelines, and MLOps workflows. Architected LangGraph-based autonomous agent systems for education automation, implemented hybrid retrieval at scale using Milvus and Pinecone, and deployed model-serving APIs on Amazon EKS. Proficient across the full AI/ML stack — from document ingestion and embedding pipelines to model evaluation, CI/CD, and observability.

experience.description: Architected and deployed production-grade multi-agent AI systems for admissions guidance and career recommendations using LangGraph supervisor–worker orchestration.
achievements: Architected and deployed a production-grade multi-agent AI assistant using LangGraph and LangChain to automate admissions guidance and career recommendations through coordinated planning, retrieval, evaluation, and response-generation agents.

Designed specialized agents for document analysis, eligibility verification, scholarship discovery, and personalized career planning using supervisor–worker orchestration patterns with dynamic routing.
Built end-to-end document ingestion pipelines using Unstructured.io for parsing, preprocessing, chunking, and metadata enrichment of PDFs, forms, and institutional documents.
Generated embeddings using OpenAI Embeddings and indexed vectors in Milvus and Pinecone with document-level and chunk-level metadata to support scalable semantic retrieval.
Implemented hybrid retrieval combining BM25 keyword search, dense vector similarity, metadata filtering, and reranking to improve citation grounding and answer relevance.
Developed query optimization pipelines using named entity recognition (NER), multi-query expansion, and metadata-aware filtering to increase retrieval precision for ambiguous questions.
Implemented ReAct-based planning workflows that decomposed complex requests into structured subtasks and dynamically selected tools and agents during action–observation loops.
Integrated tool calling with internal APIs, CRM systems, vector stores, and external scholarship and labor-market data sources.
Built short-term conversational memory and long-term persistent memory using vector stores and structured state management to preserve user context across multi-turn interactions.
Added human-in-the-loop approval workflows for sensitive recommendations, enabling review before final responses were delivered to users.
Evaluated system quality using ground-truth datasets, citation accuracy checks, tool-call success tracking, and regression testing for agent behavior.
Implemented confidence-based routing, fallback logic, retry policies, and rate limiting to improve robustness and reduce workflow failures in production.
Exposed agent services through FastAPI and deployed with Docker and Kubernetes on Amazon EKS.
Added observability using LangSmith, structured logging, Amazon CloudWatch, and Grafana for tracing, latency analysis, token usage, and retrieval diagnostics.
Optimized prompts, context-window utilization, and caching strategies, reducing inference costs by 30% while maintaining response quality and grounding fidelity.

experience.description: Built automated ML pipelines, MLOps infrastructure, and model-serving APIs for academic and talent analytics applications.
achievements: Built automated ETL pipelines to ingest academic policies, course catalogs, and student-support documents from PDFs and databases into analytics-ready storage.
Implemented data versioning using DVC and stored datasets and model artifacts in Amazon S3 for reproducibility and traceability.
Developed feature engineering workflows and maintained curated feature sets for downstream machine learning and retrieval applications.
Orchestrated data and model pipelines using Apache Airflow to automate ingestion, validation, retraining, and deployment tasks.
Used MLflow for experiment tracking, artifact management, and model version control.
Built CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions to automate testing, container builds, and deployment workflows.
Deployed model-serving APIs using FastAPI, Docker, and Kubernetes.
Implemented A/B testing infrastructure and traffic routing to compare model versions in production environments.
Added monitoring for pipeline latency, resource utilization, and prediction-service health using Amazon CloudWatch and Grafana.
Established structured logging, alerting, and failure notifications to improve operational reliability.

experience.description: Developed backend services, REST APIs, and ETL workflows supporting student analytics and internal applications.
achievements: Developed backend services and REST APIs using Python and FastAPI to support student analytics and internal applications.
Built ETL workflows to ingest and transform academic, attendance, and demographic data from relational databases.
Designed relational schemas and optimized complex PostgreSQL queries, reducing batch processing time by 35%.
Implemented automated batch processing and scheduled workflows using Apache Airflow.
Containerized applications using Docker and deployed them on Amazon EC2.
Integrated application logging, monitoring, and alerting using Amazon CloudWatch.
Collaborated with data science and business teams to productionize predictive analytics solutions and automate reporting workflows.
